SELECT en.*, u.name AS author_name FROM expense_notes en JOIN users u ON u.id = en.user_id WHERE u.company_id = $2 AND u.id <> $1 AND u.role <> 'hr_admin' AND u.manager_id = $1 AND en.status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT en.*, u.name AS author_name FROM expense_notes en JOIN users u ON u.id = en.user_id WHERE u.company_id = $2 AND u.id <> $1 AND u.role <> 'hr_admin' AND u.manager_id = $1 AND en.status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT en.*, u.name AS author_name FROM expense_notes en JOIN users u ON u.id = en.user_id WHERE u.company_id = $2 AND u.id <> $1 AND (u.role = 'hr_admin' OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM users direct_manager
    WHERE direct_manager.id = u.manager_id AND direct_manager.id <> u.id AND direct_manager.company_id = u.company_id
      AND direct_manager.role = 'manager' AND direct_manager.is_active
  )) AND en.status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC

Plans.Filter: (is_active AND (id <> u.id) AND (company_id = u.company_id) AND (id = u.manager_id) AND (role = 'manager'::text))
